parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right cabinet door of a wooden storage cabinet, made of solid or engineered wood with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a hinged cover for the right storage compartment, allowing access to the interior space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left cabinet door of a wooden storage cabinet, made of solid or engineered wood with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a hinged cover for the left storage compartment, providing access to the interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: This is the drawer of the cabinet, made of wood and fitted with a handle for pulling.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a sliding compartment for storing smaller items or utensils.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the cabinet, made of sturdy wood to support the structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevation to the cabinet, keeping it off the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structural component with no movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the cabinet, made of wood and forming the structural skeleton.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including doors, drawers, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structural component with no movement.
